result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer use `contributorsListLimit`, so every contributor is exported. The `reports` module compiles (`mvn -o test-compile`). I did not run any tests or generate a report, so the new behavior hasn't been exercised.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: I removed the `.limit(limit)` call, so `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and the bots and teams pages list everyone. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: the bar chart now iterates over all of `recentContributors`, giving one bar per recently active contributor.

The `contributorsListLimit` field and getter in `LandscapeConfiguration` are still there, so existing `config.json` files keep working. I did not commit.
